story.soThat: I can ensure correct episode execution and state management
story.tasks: - Audit existing tests from Stories 2.2-2.7 (currently ~100 tests passing) - Identify gaps in test coverage for acceptance criteria - Organize tests into logical test classes by functionality - Add missing tests for: initialization, reset, step actions, return signatures, episode completion, cumulative reward, history tracking, invalid actions - Ensure integration tests for complete episodes and deterministic behavior - Test new methods from Stories 2.6-2.7 (run(), get_config()) - Verify pytest fixtures in conftest.py are available and used - Run all tests and achieve >80% coverage for environment.py - Document test organization and coverage metrics

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
**AC1:** Tests for environment initialization validate default parameters, state dict existence, and get_config() accessibility
**AC2:** Tests for reset() validate position/timestep/cumulative_reward initialization, history clearing, and observation dict return
**AC3:** Tests for step() actions validate ACTION_LEFT/STAY/RIGHT behavior and bounds enforcement
**AC4:** Tests for step() return signature validate 4-tuple structure (observation, reward, done, info) with correct types
**AC5:** Tests for episode completion validate done flag behavior (False before limit, True at limit)
**AC6:** Tests for cumulative reward validate accumulation and final sum correctness
**AC7:** Tests for history tracking validate tuple format, length, and reset clearing
**AC8:** Tests for invalid actions validate ValueError raised with helpful messages
**AC9:** All tests use pytest fixtures from conftest.py (gaussian_function, environment, mock_agent)
**AC10:** All tests pass with >80% coverage for environment.py

doc.title: FuncBench Architecture
doc.snippet: Fixture-based test setup using conftest.py. Reproducibility testing (same seed = same results). Performance testing with pytest-benchmark or timeit. Edge case coverage (bounds, invalid inputs, episode termination). Test organization by functionality into test classes.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Environment & Agent Execution
doc.snippet: Comprehensive unit tests for all environment functionality. Test initialization, reset, step, episode completion, cumulative reward, history. Validate error handling (invalid actions). Use pytest fixtures from conftest.py. All tests must pass. Test coverage >80% for environment.py.

doc.title: Story 2.5: Episode History Tracking
doc.snippet: All 100 tests pass (69 environment + 11 agent + 20 function). TestHistoryTracking class with 10 tests added. conftest.py with fixtures available. Testing infrastructure established.

story-context.constraints: - This story is primarily about ORGANIZING and VALIDATING existing tests, not writing all tests from scratch - Many tests already exist from Stories 2.2-2.5 (~100 tests passing) - Stories 2.6-2.7 will add their own tests (run(), get_config()) - Focus on: identifying gaps, organizing into test classes, ensuring all ACs have tests - Test coverage target: >80% for environment.py (not 100% - some edge cases hard to trigger) - All tests must use fixtures from conftest.py for consistency - Test naming convention: test__ (e.g., test_reset_clears_history) - Test classes organize tests by functionality (TestInitialization, TestReset, TestStep, TestEpisode, etc.) - Performance tests use timeit for timing validation (< 2s for episodes, < 1ms for simple methods) - Integration tests validate cross-component interaction (complete episodes, determinism) - Each AC should map to specific test(s) for validation - Regression testing: ensure all existing 100 tests still pass after any changes

tests.standards: Testing standards from Architecture and established patterns: - Use pytest framework with fixtures from conftest.py - Test classes organized by functionality (TestInitialization, TestReset, TestStep, TestEpisode, TestHistory, TestConfig, TestRun) - Test naming: test__ (e.g., test_step_action_left) - NumPy-style docstrings on test methods explaining what is being tested - Performance tests use timeit for timing validation - Edge case coverage: bounds enforcement, invalid inputs, episode termination - Integration tests validate cross-component interaction - Regression testing: all existing tests must still pass - Coverage target: >80% line coverage for environment.py - Use pytest-cov for coverage measurement: pytest --cov=funcbench.environment
tests.locations: tests/test_environment.py - Main test file (currently ~1085 lines, ~100 tests) tests/conftest.py - Pytest fixtures
tests.ideas:
**Test Organization Structure:**
Class TestInitialization: - test_environment_default_parameters - test_environment_custom_parameters - test_environment_state_dict_structure - test_environment_stores_function_reference
Class TestReset: - test_reset_position_to_zero - test_reset_timestep_to_zero - test_reset_cumulative_reward_to_zero - test_reset_clears_history - test_reset_returns_observation_dict - test_reset_observation_structure - test_reset_multiple_calls
Class TestStep: - test_step_action_left_decreases_position - test_step_action_stay_unchanged_position - test_step_action_right_increases_position - test_step_bounds_enforcement_left - test_step_bounds_enforcement_right - test_step_custom_step_size - test_step_returns_four_tuple - test_step_observation_dict_structure - test_step_reward_type_float - test_step_done_type_bool - test_step_info_dict_structure - test_step_invalid_action_raises_error
Class TestEpisode: - test_episode_done_false_before_length - test_episode_done_true_at_length - test_episode_timestep_increments - test_episode_cumulative_reward_accumulates - test_episode_cumulative_reward_sum_matches
Class TestHistory (may already exist from Story 2.5): - test_history_entry_tuple_format - test_history_length_equals_steps - test_history_cleared_on_reset - test_history_content_correctness
Class TestObservation (may already exist from Story 2.3): - test_observation_gradient_samples_count - test_observation_within_radius - test_observation_bounds_clipping
Class TestIntegration: - test_complete_episode_100_steps - test_multiple_sequential_episodes - test_deterministic_episode_same_seed - test_environment_with_mock_agent
**Gap Analysis:** Based on Story 2.5 completion notes, existing tests cover: - Environment initialization (Story 2.2) - Reset functionality (Story 2.2) - Observation generation (Story 2.3) - Step execution (Story 2.4 - 31 tests added) - History tracking (Story 2.5 - 10 tests added)
Likely gaps to fill: - Integration tests for complete episodes - Deterministic episode tests (reproducibility) - Tests for run() method (Story 2.6 will add these) - Tests for get_config() method (Story 2.7 will add these)
**Coverage Target:** - Current: Unknown, but likely good given 100 tests passing - Goal: >80% line coverage for environment.py - Measurement: pytest --cov=funcbench.environment --cov-report=html
